title: ScientistTwo: Pioneering the Human Knowledge Frontier with Autonomous AI

sources.purpose: Canonical title, original publication timestamp and author identity.
Full method, literal Fig.4 control flow, author results, cost subgroup and implementation settings.
Official project and generated-paper gallery; not proof of framework source release.

upstream_code.scope: Fixed v1 and the inspected official project entry do not link a verifiable complete ScientistTwo framework release. Public generated papers/solver artifacts, third-party replicas and reused PaperOrchestra/ScholarPeer components are not counted as its framework source. This is a bounded entry-point check, not an exhaustive claim about every possible repository.

local_components: Subset Good to independent full-experiment escalation
History-driven external proposals plus externally novelty-ranked untried seeds
external_responsibilities: Scientific code execution and data splits
fidelity_notes: The final Fig.4 refinement may execute, but the unreviewed result is not accepted.
Subset Good never becomes full Good automatically; full Bad/Engineer outcomes remain intact.
Good/Bad history is preserved; no fixed scalar stands in for a semantic critic.
Review-call accounting is explicitly local and is not presented as the complete meta-review workflow.
No gold, model, scientific result, API call, CUDA path or Evolve integration is supplied.

full_experiment.basis: The paper evaluates 107 problems. Section 4.3 analyzes a 33-problem NeurIPS-derived subgroup and reports about 2–3 days per problem (about 2.5 mean) and USD 3765 mean including tokens and VMs. These are author-environment measurements, not local timings and not a direct total for all 107 tasks. Multi-agent commercial calls, full scientific experiments and writing are out of budget; no probe or checkpoint/PDF-bundle download was attempted.

figure.render: Original official HTML PNG bytes; no PDF renderer, crop or redraw.
